title: front
description: Fog-front estimate published by the station's network intelligence (M8) for the dashboard (M10).
x-rate: on every new detection, and every 10 s while a front is active

active.description: A fog front is currently being tracked.

direction_deg.description: Direction the front moves toward, clockwise from north (0 = moving north, 90 = moving east).

fit_quality.description: How well the detections fit a straight front: 1 = perfect.

nodes_detected.description: Nodes that have reported FOG_DETECTED for this front, in order.

eta_s.description: Expected arrival at each node not yet reached, seconds after ts.
